harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built guest-network isolation on OpenWrt node1: added two new zones (trusted=lan-a on eth1/192.168.10.0/24 linking node2, guest=lan-b on eth2/192.168.20.0/24 linking node3), allowed trusted->guest forwarding, left guest->trusted unforwarded (default reject), and kept DNS (dnsmasq) reachable from guest via zone input=ACCEPT. Configured static routing on node2/node3's secondary NICs so cross-subnet traffic transits node1. Verified with real TCP tests and a raw DNS query, both before and after restarting all three nodes one at a time (boot_id changed on each, config/services recovered).
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (OpenWrt), node2, node3 network topology and found each node2/node3 has a second unused NIC (enp8s0) wired to node1's eth1/eth2 respectively, separate from the shared management NIC
Configured node1 UCI network: new interfaces 'trusted' (eth1, 192.168.10.1/24) and 'guest' (eth2, 192.168.20.1/24)
Configured node1 UCI dhcp: added dnsmasq listen entries for 'trusted' and 'guest' interfaces (ignore=1, DNS-only)
Configured node1 UCI firewall: zones 'trusted' (forward=REJECT) and 'guest' (forward=REJECT), plus explicit forwarding trusted->guest; left guest->trusted with no forwarding rule (default reject)
Reloaded network, firewall, dnsmasq on node1 without touching eth0/br-lan (preserved exec/management access)
Configured node2 (nmcli) enp8s0 static 192.168.10.2/24 + route to 192.168.20.0/24 via 192.168.10.1
Configured node3 (nmcli) enp8s0 static 192.168.20.2/24 + route to 192.168.10.0/24 via 192.168.20.1
Installed tcpdump on node1 to trace SYN packets across eth1/eth2 and confirm forward vs. block behavior at the packet level
Verified via HTTP test servers and raw DNS UDP query: trusted->guest TCP succeeds, guest->trusted TCP is rejected at node1 (SYN never forwarded), guest->node1 DNS succeeds
Cleaned up temporary firewalld port openings and test HTTP servers on node2/node3
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, uptime, interface/service state) on all three nodes
Restarted node1 via 'reboot', node2 and node3 via 'systemctl reboot', one at a time, each acknowledged before disconnect
Polled each node until exec access returned and confirmed boot_id changed on all three
Re-verified UCI/firewall config, NIC addressing, and routes persisted after each restart
Re-ran full end-to-end isolation test (trusted->guest allow, guest->trusted block, guest->DNS allow) after all three restarts to prove functional recovery
Cleaned up final test artifacts (HTTP servers, firewalld port rules) on node2/node3

evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy state captured pre-restart for all nodes
evidence.summary: boot_id, uptime, interface/connection state captured on node1, node2, node3 before any restart

evidence.requirement: Guest (lan-b/node3) cannot open connection to trusted (lan-a/node2)
evidence.summary: curl from node3 to node2:8000 fails; tcpdump on node1 shows SYN arrives on eth2 (guest) but is never forwarded out eth1 (trusted), proving the firewall blocks it at node1

evidence.requirement: Trusted (lan-a/node2) keeps full access to guest (lan-b/node3)
evidence.summary: curl from node2 to node3:8000 returns HTTP 200

evidence.requirement: Guests can reach services node1 itself offers (DNS)
evidence.summary: Raw DNS UDP query from node3 to node1's guest-zone IP 192.168.20.1:53 returns a valid 88-byte DNS reply

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement returns before disconnect, boot identity changes, config/services recover
evidence.summary: reboot scheduled and acknowledged; subsequent poll times out (disconnect); next poll succeeds with new boot_id 003ecdf3... (was 3be233d1...) and uptime reset; firewall/network config and services confirmed intact post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement returns before disconnect, boot identity changes, config recovers
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot scheduled and acknowledged; poll times out then succeeds with new boot_id 51ea685e... (was bf4e9cbb...); enp8s0 static IP and route to guest subnet confirmed intact post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement returns before disconnect, boot identity changes, config recovers
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot scheduled and acknowledged; poll times out then succeeds with new boot_id 25cfdc3a... (was 6bb7e004...); enp8s0 static IP and route to trusted subnet confirmed intact post-reboot

evidence.requirement: Full isolation behavior re-verified functionally after all three nodes were restarted
evidence.summary: Post-restart: trusted->guest HTTP succeeds (code=200), guest->trusted HTTP is refused, and guest->node1 DNS query returns a valid reply, confirming the isolation policy and services survived all three node restarts

evidence.requirement: Test artifacts cleaned up, no leftover state
evidence.summary: Temporary firewalld port 8000/tcp removed and no http.server processes remain on node2/node3
